---
title: Supplementary sections without numbered sections
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'S1 First supplement' 'S2 Second supplement' 'Figure S1: First square' 'Appendix A'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          ! printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE 'S1\.1|A\.1 ' || { echo "a sub-heading is numbered"; exit 1; }
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE 'Body text.*Appendix A.*Appendix detail.*S1 First supplement.*Sub-section' || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

# First supplement {.supplementary}

![First square.](figure.svg){#fig-first fig-alt="A blue square."}

## Sub-section

Sub-section text.

# Body

Body text.

# Extra {.appendix}

## Appendix detail

Appendix text.

# Second supplement {.supplementary}

Second text.
